title: Introduction To The New Heavstal Invoice System
text:
To Our Dear Esteemed Users,
Heavstal Tech has just launched a new invoice system, hence any payments made within any Heavstal Services (third-party or not) will be recorded in the new billing page. 

Make a payment today and check out your invoice at: https://heavstal.com.ng/dashboard/billing

title: Notice of Domain Migration.
text:
Dear Esteemed User,
This is to inform you that we've migrated our domain, if you're using the old domain please update your apps to use the new "https://heavstal.com.ng"

Heavstal Tech Team
